title: Zulay Kitchen Milk Frother Handheld Electric Whisk – Frother Wand, Durable Drink Mixer, Coffee Frother, Hand Blender, Frother for Protein Powder, Matcha & More - Black
features: CREAMY VELVETY FROTH IN SECONDS: Making coffee-shop-style recipes at home is as simple as it can be with this milk frother. The 13,000 RPM motor and 25 spiral rings on the frother let you whip up rich foam in no time. Level up your day with this frother for protein powder, warm or cold coffee, latte, cappuccino, hot chocolate, matcha, and powdered drinks.

SIMPLE COFFEE MAKING EXPERIENCE: We have designed this hand blender with a comfortable grip and a simple on/off button. From your morning latte to whisking eggs for omelets, this electric whisk can do it all. Carry this portable frother handheld to make coffee anytime, anywhere.

LIFETIME FROTHING ACCESSORY: This drink mixer, with rust-resistant stainless steel and a sleek nylon body, is built to be your coffee accessory for years. Powered by 2 Duracell batteries (not included), the coffee frother works on all types of milk, such as oat, soy, almond, and other dairy items like butter or cream. Let this frother wand take care of the job for you.

EASY TO CLEAN AND STORE: To clean this hand frother, simply place the whisk under water and briefly turn it on to get rid of any residue; wipe the handle with a damp cloth. Our hand blender can easily fit in your bag or in your kitchen drawer when not in use.

HASSLE-FREE, ZULAY GUARANTEE: We love and take pride in our frother for coffee and back it up with a lifetime guarantee. If there are any issues, just contact us, and we will make it right (even after the Amazon return window is closed). Foam is where this frother is!
